adjudication.rationale: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb, the feed is fetched with `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)`. Because `open-uri` is required (`require 'open-uri'`), this calls Kernel#open/open-uri. Kernel#open treats strings beginning with `|` as a command to execute via a pipe (e.g., `open('|cmd')`), which can lead to command execution if the string is attacker-controlled. `SiteSetting.feed_polling_url` is an admin-configurable setting added in this diff, so the code introduces a verifiable command-injection risk. Using `URI.parse(...).open` / `URI.open` (or otherwise rejecting leading `|`/non-HTTP(S) schemes) would avoid this behavior.
